次女適徐州刺史羊忱兒
亮子被蘇峻害攺適江虨
恢兒娶鄧攸女于時
謝尚書求其小女㛰恢乃云羊鄧是世㛰江家我顧
伊庾家伊顧我不能復與謝裒兒㛰
及恢亡遂㛰
於是王右軍往謝家看
新婦猶有恢之遺法威儀端詳容服光整王歎曰我
在遣女裁得爾耳

reviews.explanation: The mention 庾亮 appears in the main text as 太尉庾亮 (Grand Commandant Yu Liang). The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-002) explicitly references 庾氏譜 and states 庾亮子會娶恢女, confirming the identity of 庾亮 in this passage. The canonical name match is exact and the contextual role (太尉) is consistent with the historical Yu Liang. The annotation provides direct genealogical evidence tying this 庾亮 to the marriage narrative in the main text.

The mention 太尉庾亮 combines the office title 太尉 with the name 庾亮. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-002) confirms 庾亮 as the father of 庾會 who married 諸葛恢's daughter, directly matching the main text narrative. The office title 太尉 is consistent with Yu Liang's historical role. The coreference with sfh1-mention-00799377bed9d58d60dfd623 (庾亮) is well-supported by the annotation evidence.

The mention 鄧攸 appears in the main text as 恢兒娶鄧攸女 (Hui's son married Deng You's daughter). The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-007) states 至滎陽太守娶河南鄧攸女, confirming 鄧攸 as the father of the woman married into the Zhuge family. The canonical name match is exact and the genealogical context in the annotation directly corroborates the main text reference.

The mention 王右軍 is resolved to 王羲之 based on the alias registry entry for office title 右軍. However, the candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-734fd9f3965b0fc8a2ab) is from data/aliases.json and contains a completely different text (謝太傅語王右軍曰...) that is not from this story. The main text of this story (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-main) mentions 王右軍 in the context of visiting the Xie family to see the new bride of Zhuge Hui's daughter. While 王右軍 could plausibly refer to 王羲之 (who held the office of 右軍將軍), the supplied evidence does not specifically support this identification within this story's context. The alias registry evidence is from an unrelated passage and does not establish that this particular 王右軍 mention refers to 王羲之. The reference semantics returned 'fail closed' with low confidence and no supporting semantic record. Without direct evidence linking this specific mention to 王羲之, the resolution cannot be accepted.

The proposed resolution maps the office title 侍中 to 謝安. However, the annotation evidence (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-005) explicitly states '父忱侍中' — that 忱 (羊忱, the father of 羊楷) held the office of 侍中. The reference semantics themselves identify the holder as 羊忱 (sfh1-mention-ddaebb349d04b83dcb78f61e), not 謝安. The candidate evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-eb8a5e6a0f93550e1ca6) merely contains the surface '侍中' with no connection to 謝安. There is no evidence that 謝安 held this office in this passage. The office holder is explicitly 羊忱 per the annotation. This is a clear office-holder identity mismatch.

The surface 蘇峻 is a full personal name directly matching the canonical name 蘇峻. The main text (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-main) states '亮子被蘇峻害' — Su Jun harmed 庾亮's son. This is a direct name match with clear contextual role support. The distinctness constraints from other named persons in the passage are consistent. Accept.

The surface 王 is the surname component of the office title 王右軍 (Wang Youjun), which is a well-known alias for 王羲之 (Wang Xizhi). The alias registry evidence (sfh1-candidate-evidence-fd29b026a45552588f43) explicitly contains '謝太傅語王右軍曰' confirming the office title usage. The main text (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-main) also contains '於是王右軍往謝家看'. The reference semantics correctly identify this as an abbreviated reference coreferent with the full 王右軍 mention. The alias registry maps 王右軍 to 王羲之. Accept.

The surface 庾亮 is a full personal name directly matching the canonical name 庾亮. The main text (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-main) states '諸葛恢大女適太尉庾亮兒' and '亮子被蘇峻害' — 庾亮's son was harmed by Su Jun. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-002) confirms '庾氏譜曰庾亮子會娶恢女'. The name match is direct and the contextual role (father of the son harmed by Su Jun) is consistent with the historical 庾亮. Accept.

The mention 鄧攸 is a full personal name in the main text ('恢兒娶鄧攸女'). The Liu annotation sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-007 explicitly states '娶河南鄧攸女' (married the daughter of 鄧攸 of Henan), confirming the identity of this 鄧攸. The annotation directly corroborates the main text reference. The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-26e2faa20471a55b5df7 provides the canonical name 鄧攸. The identity is supported by direct textual evidence linking the mention to the person 鄧攸.

The mention 謝尚書 is an office-holder reference (尚書) with surname 謝. The main text itself clarifies the referent: '我不能復與謝裒兒㛰' — the person is 謝裒, not 謝尚. The candidate proposes resolution to 謝尚, but the text explicitly names the person as 謝裒. The Liu annotation sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-009 states '裒歷侍中吏部尚書' (裒 served as 侍中 and 吏部尚書), confirming that 謝裒 held the office of 尚書. Annotation sfh1-ev-05-fangzheng-025-liu-annotation-010 further confirms '謝氏譜曰裒子石娶恢小女'. The office title 尚書 refers to 謝裒, not 謝尚. The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-ec16c30d274014612c0a matches the surface 謝尚書 to 謝尚, but the surrounding text and annotations unambiguously identify this 謝尚書 as 謝裒. This is a misattribution based on surname+office matching without checking the specific person named in context.
